chapterInfo.content:
4
Ogufoɔ ho bɛ
(Mateo 13.1-23; Luka 8.4-15)
1Na ɔfitii aseɛ kyerɛkyerɛɛ bio wɔ mpoano; na nkurɔfokuo pii hyia baa ne nkyɛn, enti ɔkɔɔ kodoɔ mu kɔtenaa ase ɛpo no ani; na nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa wɔ mpoano asase no so. 2Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn nnoɔma pii wɔ mmebuo mu, na ɔsee wɔn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu sɛ: 3Montie: Hwɛ, ogufoɔ bi firii adi kɔguu aba. 4Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔreguo no, ebi kɔguu kwankyɛn; na ewiem nnomaa ba bɛsosɔeɛ. 5Na ebi kɔguu aboɔ so, deɛ dɔteɛ pii nnie; na ntɛm ara na ɛfifiriiɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na dɔteɛ no mu nnɔ ntira; 6na owia firiiɛ no, ɛkusaeɛ, ɛsiane sɛ na ɛnni nhini nti, ɛwuiɛ. 7Na ebi kɔguu nkasɛɛ mu; na nkasɛɛ no nyiniiɛ, na ɛmiaa no, na anso aba. 8Na ebi kɔguu asase pa mu; na ɛfifirii kɔɔ so nyinii na ɛtrɛe na ɛsoe, ebi aduasa, ebi aduosia, ebi ɔha. 9Na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie! 10Na ɛkaa ɔno nko no, wɔn a wɔwɔ ne ho ne dummienu no bisaa no ɛbɛ no ase. 11#1 Ko 5.12-13; Kol 4.5; 1 Te 4.12; 1 Ti 3.7 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo deɛ, wɔde ama mo sɛ monhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie ho ahuntasɛm no; na wɔn a wɔwɔ akyire no deɛ, wɔkyerɛ wɔn ne nyinaa mmebuo mu;
12 # Yes 6.9-10 na ehunu deɛ wɔahunu, na wɔanhunu mu,
na ɛteɛ nso wɔate, na wɔante aseɛ,
na da bi wɔansakyera, na wɔamfa wɔn bɔne ankyɛ wɔn.
13Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monnim bɛ yi? Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mobɛhunu mmɛ no nyinaa?
14 Ogufoɔ no gu asɛm no. 15Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔwɔ kwankyɛn no: Faako a wɔgu asɛm no, sɛ wɔnya te a, ntɛm ara Satan ba, na ɔbɛyi asɛm a wɔagu wɔ wɔn mu no. 16Na yeinom nso ne wɔn a wɔgu wɔn aboɔ so no: Wɔn na wɔnya te asɛm no a, ntɛm ara wɔde anigyeɛ gye, 17na ɛnnye nhini wɔn mu, na wɔwɔ hɔ berɛ tiaa bi; na akyire yi no, sɛ asɛm no nti ahohia anaa ɔtaa ba a, ntɛm ara na ato wɔn suntidua. 18Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔgu wɔn nkasɛɛ mu no: Wɔne wɔn a wɔte asɛm no, 19#Mar 10.23-24 na ɔbra yi mu dadwene ne ahonyadeɛ nnaadaa ne nnoɔma a ɛkeka ho no ho akɔnnɔ ba mu a, ɛmia asɛm no, na ɛnso aba. 20Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔguu wɔn asase pa mu no: Wɔn a wɔte asɛm no, na wɔgyeɛ, na wɔso aba, ebi aduasa, na ebi aduosia, na ebi ɔha.
Kanea adwuma
(Luka 8.16-18)
21 # Mat 5.15 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Wɔde kanea ba sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ koraa anaasɛ mpa ase anaa? Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛsi kaneadua soɔ anaa? 22#Mat 10.26; Luka 12.2 Na biribiara nni kɔkoam a wɔrenyi no adie, anaasɛ wɔde ahunta a ɛrenna adie. 23Sɛ obi wɔ aso a ɔde bɛtie a, ma no ntie! 24#Mat 7.2 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ yie deɛ moteɛ no ho. Susukoraa ko a mode susuo no, wɔde bɛsusu ama mo, na wɔde bi bɛka mo ho. 25#Mat 13.12 Na deɛ ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no bebree; na deɛ ɔnnie no, deɛ ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye afiri ne nsam!
Aba a ɛno ara fifire
26Na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie no teɛ nie: Ɛte sɛ onipa bi bɛgu aba wɔ fam, 27#Yak 5.7 na ɔda, na ɔnyane anadwo ne awia, na aba no fifire, na ɛnyini, na ɔnnim sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ. 28Na asase no ara so aba, ɛyi ahahan kane, na afei ayɛ bɛtem, na afei ayɛ ayuo a anyini bɛtem no mu. 29Na sɛ aba no nyini a, ntɛm ara ɔsoma ma wɔde kantankrankyi kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ twaberɛ no adu.
Sinapi aba ho bɛ
(Mateo 13.31-32, 34; Luka 13.18-19)
30Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ho na yɛde Nyankopɔn ahennie no bɛtoɔ? Anaasɛ ɛbɛ bɛn na yɛbɛbu no ho? 31Ɛte sɛ sinapi aba fua a wɔdua no fam a ɛyɛ aba ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu ketewa, 32na wɔdua a, ɛnyini na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ sene fan nyinaa, na ɛyiyi mman akɛseɛ, na ewiem nnomaa tumi tena ne nwunu ase. 33Na mmɛ a ɛtete sɛɛ pii na ɔde kaa asɛm kyerɛɛ wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔtumi te aseɛ. 34Na wankwati bɛ ankasa ankyerɛ wɔn; na ɛka wɔn nko ara a, ɔkyerɛ n’asuafoɔ no ne nyinaa ase.
Ahum no asebrɛ
(Mateo 8.23-27; Luka 8.22-25)
35Na da no ara, ɛduruu anwummerɛ no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Momma yɛntwa nkɔ asuogya nohoa. 36Na wɔgyaa nkurɔfokuo no kwan no, wɔfaa no kaa wɔn ho kodoɔ no mu sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ no ara; na akodoɔ bi nso ka ne ho. 37Na ahum kɛseɛ bi tui, na asorɔkyeɛ bubu bɛguu kodoɔ no mu a na ɛreyɛ ayɛ ma. 38Na ɔno deɛ ɔwɔ kodoɔ no to, ada sumiiɛ so. Ɛnna wɔnyanee no see no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, yɛremem yi, ɛmfa wo ho anaa? 39Na Yesu sɔre teateaa mframa no, na ɔsee ɛpo no sɛ: Mua w’ano; yɛ komm! Na mframa no gyaee, na ɛyɛɛ dinn koraa. 40Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyɛ ahufoɔ sɛɛ? Adɛn na monni gyidie? 41Na wɔsuroo yie, na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Onipa bɛn ara ni na mframa ne ɛpo mpo tie no yi?

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔfitii aseɛ kyerɛkyerɛɛ bio wɔ mpoano; na nkurɔfokuo pii hyia baa ne nkyɛn, enti ɔkɔɔ kodoɔ mu kɔtenaa ase ɛpo no ani; na nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa wɔ mpoano asase no so. Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn nnoɔma pii wɔ mmebuo mu, na ɔsee wɔn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu sɛ: Montie: Hwɛ, ogufoɔ bi firii adi kɔguu aba. Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔreguo no, ebi kɔguu kwankyɛn; na ewiem nnomaa ba bɛsosɔeɛ. Na ebi kɔguu aboɔ so, deɛ dɔteɛ pii nnie; na ntɛm ara na ɛfifiriiɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na dɔteɛ no mu nnɔ ntira; na owia firiiɛ no, ɛkusaeɛ, ɛsiane sɛ na ɛnni nhini nti, ɛwuiɛ. Na ebi kɔguu nkasɛɛ mu; na nkasɛɛ no nyiniiɛ, na ɛmiaa no, na anso aba. Na ebi kɔguu asase pa mu; na ɛfifirii kɔɔ so nyinii na ɛtrɛe na ɛsoe, ebi aduasa, ebi aduosia, ebi ɔha. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie! Na ɛkaa ɔno nko no, wɔn a wɔwɔ ne ho ne dummienu no bisaa no ɛbɛ no ase. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo deɛ, wɔde ama mo sɛ monhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie ho ahuntasɛm no; na wɔn a wɔwɔ akyire no deɛ, wɔkyerɛ wɔn ne nyinaa mmebuo mu;
na ehunu deɛ wɔahunu, na wɔanhunu mu,
na ɛteɛ nso wɔate, na wɔante aseɛ,
na da bi wɔansakyera, na wɔamfa wɔn bɔne ankyɛ wɔn.
Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monnim bɛ yi? Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mobɛhunu mmɛ no nyinaa?
Ogufoɔ no gu asɛm no. Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔwɔ kwankyɛn no: Faako a wɔgu asɛm no, sɛ wɔnya te a, ntɛm ara Satan ba, na ɔbɛyi asɛm a wɔagu wɔ wɔn mu no. Na yeinom nso ne wɔn a wɔgu wɔn aboɔ so no: Wɔn na wɔnya te asɛm no a, ntɛm ara wɔde anigyeɛ gye, na ɛnnye nhini wɔn mu, na wɔwɔ hɔ berɛ tiaa bi; na akyire yi no, sɛ asɛm no nti ahohia anaa ɔtaa ba a, ntɛm ara na ato wɔn suntidua. Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔgu wɔn nkasɛɛ mu no: Wɔne wɔn a wɔte asɛm no, na ɔbra yi mu dadwene ne ahonyadeɛ nnaadaa ne nnoɔma a ɛkeka ho no ho akɔnnɔ ba mu a, ɛmia asɛm no, na ɛnso aba. Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔguu wɔn asase pa mu no: Wɔn a wɔte asɛm no, na wɔgyeɛ, na wɔso aba, ebi aduasa, na ebi aduosia, na ebi ɔha.


Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Wɔde kanea ba sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ koraa anaasɛ mpa ase anaa? Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛsi kaneadua soɔ anaa? Na biribiara nni kɔkoam a wɔrenyi no adie, anaasɛ wɔde ahunta a ɛrenna adie. Sɛ obi wɔ aso a ɔde bɛtie a, ma no ntie! Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ yie deɛ moteɛ no ho. Susukoraa ko a mode susuo no, wɔde bɛsusu ama mo, na wɔde bi bɛka mo ho. Na deɛ ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no bebree; na deɛ ɔnnie no, deɛ ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye afiri ne nsam!

Na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie no teɛ nie: Ɛte sɛ onipa bi bɛgu aba wɔ fam, na ɔda, na ɔnyane anadwo ne awia, na aba no fifire, na ɛnyini, na ɔnnim sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ. Na asase no ara so aba, ɛyi ahahan kane, na afei ayɛ bɛtem, na afei ayɛ ayuo a anyini bɛtem no mu. Na sɛ aba no nyini a, ntɛm ara ɔsoma ma wɔde kantankrankyi kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ twaberɛ no adu.


Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ho na yɛde Nyankopɔn ahennie no bɛtoɔ? Anaasɛ ɛbɛ bɛn na yɛbɛbu no ho? Ɛte sɛ sinapi aba fua a wɔdua no fam a ɛyɛ aba ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu ketewa, na wɔdua a, ɛnyini na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ sene fan nyinaa, na ɛyiyi mman akɛseɛ, na ewiem nnomaa tumi tena ne nwunu ase. Na mmɛ a ɛtete sɛɛ pii na ɔde kaa asɛm kyerɛɛ wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔtumi te aseɛ. Na wankwati bɛ ankasa ankyerɛ wɔn; na ɛka wɔn nko ara a, ɔkyerɛ n’asuafoɔ no ne nyinaa ase.


Na da no ara, ɛduruu anwummerɛ no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Momma yɛntwa nkɔ asuogya nohoa. Na wɔgyaa nkurɔfokuo no kwan no, wɔfaa no kaa wɔn ho kodoɔ no mu sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ no ara; na akodoɔ bi nso ka ne ho. Na ahum kɛseɛ bi tui, na asorɔkyeɛ bubu bɛguu kodoɔ no mu a na ɛreyɛ ayɛ ma. Na ɔno deɛ ɔwɔ kodoɔ no to, ada sumiiɛ so. Ɛnna wɔnyanee no see no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, yɛremem yi, ɛmfa wo ho anaa? Na Yesu sɔre teateaa mframa no, na ɔsee ɛpo no sɛ: Mua w’ano; yɛ komm! Na mframa no gyaee, na ɛyɛɛ dinn koraa. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyɛ ahufoɔ sɛɛ? Adɛn na monni gyidie? Na wɔsuroo yie, na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Onipa bɛn ara ni na mframa ne ɛpo mpo tie no yi?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
